newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: No early Venezuela electric rate rise seen-Arrieta.
newsitem.headline: No early Venezuela electric rate rise seen-Arrieta.

text.p: Venezuelan ministers denied Tuesday there would be an immediate increase in electricity tariffs, countering reports of an imminent hike, but left the door open for later rises.
"The Energy ministry doesn't know of any plans that speak of an increase in electricity prices for either today or later this week," Energy and Mines Minister Erwin Arrieta told reporters.
"The CREE is constantly evaluating tariffs ... Once their studies are completed, the situation will be analyzed and decisions will be made."
The Ministry chairs the Electric Regulatory Commission (CREE) which sets rates.
Late last year, the government said tariffs would be increased in January after new rate setting guidelines had been established.
Leading stock-market listed utility Electricidad de Caracas closed up 1.89 bolivars on the day at 489.95.
